meta.descricao: A community programme by Valejas A.C. Social for people aged 50 and over. Choir, chi kung, painting, computer skills, traditional dancing, sueca (a card game) and billiards.

cabecalho.tagline: Growing older with the club, not away from it
cabecalho.intro: A place to learn new things, stay active and make friends. It isn't a school or a care home — it's the part of the club where life carries on after 50.

arcos.alt: A Senior Academy participant plays the coloured hoops game on the ground, while children and other seniors wait their turn.
arcos.legenda: The hoops game, shared with the youngsters.

roda.alt: Seniors and children playing a ring game outdoors, arms outstretched, in the playground.
roda.legenda: A ring game in the playground.

labirintos.alt: A senior helps a child balance a ball in a maze made from a box and cardboard tubes.

oQueSeFaz.texto: You don't need to know anything beforehand. No activity requires experience.

chiKung.descricao: Slow movement and breathing, for balance and joints.

fitSenior.descricao: Adapted exercise, designed to keep up strength and independence.

dancasTradicionais.descricao: The dances people have always loved, with music and company.

coro.descricao: Singing together, and nobody asks for your CV.

pintura.descricao: Classes for those who've never held a brush and for those who have.

informatica.descricao: Phones, computers and online services, at your own pace.

saude.descricao: Sessions about the body, ageing and what to do with both.

sueca.descricao: A traditional card game (Portuguese), with competitions organised by the club at the clubhouse tables.

bilhar.descricao: Its own competitions too, with an audience too.

cultura.descricao: Visits, get-togethers and whatever the season calls for.

maisNovos.texto: Every now and then, the Academy joins the children for playground games: ring games, hoops and cardboard mazes, shared between generations.

porque.paragrafo1: A club isn't just the people who play. The Senior Academy exists to fight isolation and keep active a part of the community that still belongs to Valejas long after it stops competing.
porque.paragrafo2: There are sueca and billiards competitions organised by the club, group trips to the theatre, and people who come along just for the company. That counts too.

cta.texto: Drop by the clubhouse during Academy hours, or get in touch. All you need is to be a member — membership is {quota} a month.
